Babies have delicate and sensitive skin, which makes them susceptible to irritations, rashes, itching, and infections. Your baby needs a good body lotion that is moisturizing and gentle on the skin. Using the right baby lotion can make the baby’s skin soft and supple. The best baby lotions are easy to use, safe for sensitive skin, and free of allergens and harsh chemicals. Here, we have compiled a list of the best baby lotions in India. Talk to your pediatrician and pick a product that is best for your baby.

How To Choose The Right Baby Lotion In India?

Before choosing a baby lotion, be sure to consider the following factors. 

  1. List of ingredients: Check carefully the ingredients listed on the bottle. Chemicals and other additives may cause allergies and rashes on the baby’s sensitive skin. Ensure that the lotion you buy is free from parabens, PEG, sulfates, phthalates, and fragrances. Choose products with more natural ingredients, and the fewer ingredients listed the better.
  1. Allergens: As babies have delicate and sensitive skin, they are prone to rashes and allergic reactions. Choose a hypoallergenic lotion that does not irritate sensitive skin.
  1. pH balanced lotions: A ph level of 5.5 is ideal for a baby’s skin. Since it is vital to maintain a healthy skin balance, choose a lotion with a pH level close to 5.5 to suit the baby’s skin.
  1. Type of packaging and dispenser: The bottle’s size depends on whether you need to use it while on the go or at home. A small bottle that can be put in a diaper bag is convenient when traveling. The type of dispenser is also crucial for ease of use. Choose a pump or pouring style bottle according to your convenience.
  1. Value for money: High-quality baby lotions made from safe ingredients are expensive. Therefore, it is recommended to combine two packs or even larger bottles for home use.

Gopa Bezboruah, a mom and travel blogger, says, “Always do a patch test before applying a new lotion on your baby—even if you had used the same lotion on an older sibling. Furthermore, ensure the product is free of fragrances and nasty chemicals and avoid using multiple products.”

Frequently Asked Questions

1. When can I start using baby lotion and cream for my baby?

When the baby is about two months old, you can start using lotion. Typically, for newborn babies with normal skin, lotions and creams are not needed, but for babies with dry skin, rashes, and irritation, this may be beneficial.

2. Can I use moisturizing lotion on the baby’s face?

The baby’s face has natural moisturizers, so there is no need to use lotion on the face, but if the baby’s skin is dry, you can use a fragrance-free lotion.

A good moisturizing lotion can save your baby from skin rashes, irritation, and dryness. A soothing lotion that is not too strong would work best on babies’ soft and delicate skin. Further, compact bottled cream would be easy to carry in a bag without creating a mess. However, research the ingredients used before buying a lotion as your baby could be allergic to certain ingredients. The products listed above are of premium quality and safe to use on your baby’s sensitive skin. So compare each product and take your pick.
